sentences.en: Let's take advantage of the vacation to mow the lawn.
sentences.zh: 让我们利用假期把草坪修剪一下。

sentences.en: I think it's time for me to mow the lawn.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在是我该修剪草坪的时候了。

sentences.en: I want you to mow the lawn right after breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我希望你吃完早饭后马上去修剪草坪。

senses.zh: 草坪，草地；上等细棉布，上等细麻布
